text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"Very heavy rainfall of 150 mm poses localized flooding risk to ground floor residents.","main_move":"GO_UP","main_move_text":"Move yourself, essential valuables, and electrical items to an upper floor.","where_to_go":"Upper floor of your current building or stay on higher ground in AC Block","do_now":[{"text":"Move essential items, electronics, and documents to upper shelves or higher floors.","advice_ids":["ADV_FLOOD_PREP_01"]},{"text":"Keep your mobile phone fully charged and stock drinking water and emergency lights.","advice_ids":["ADV_EMERGENCY_KIT_01"]},{"text":"Disconnect main electrical supply if floodwater begins entering your ground floor home.","advice_ids":["ADV_ELEC_SAFETY_01"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not drive or walk through flooded subways like Madley, Doraiswamy, or Rangarajapuram subways.","advice_ids":["ADV_SUBWAY_AVOID_01"]},{"text":"Do not touch electrical equipment or switches with wet hands or while standing in water.","advice_ids":["ADV_ELEC_SAFETY_02"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"On ground floor with water entering the house","text":"Move upstairs immediately and alert neighbours.","advice_ids":["ADV_FLOOD_EVAC_01"]}],"call":["1913","112","101"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Location and flood risk level are clear for ground-floor indoors during heavy rain.","unknowns":["Exact localized street water level immediately outside AC Block"],"valid_while":["During active heavy rain and waterlogging alerts in Chennai"]}
